session.modelSwitched: Switched model to {{model}} — the conversation will continue with the new model
session.effortSwitched: Switched thinking effort to {{effort}} — the conversation will continue with the new setting
session.continuedAfterInterrupt: Reconnected to the backend session via "continue" (memory preserved) — the previous interruption in core has ended
session.yoloExpired: YOLO (30 minutes) has expired and automatically fell back to normal permission-confirmation mode
session.contextCheckpointRestarted: [S8] Context usage reached the threshold — automatically checkpoint-restarted (resumed from the previous conversation summary, same session)
session.permissionTimeoutDenied: The permission request timed out and was automatically denied
session.revivedResumed: The agent was restarted and reconnected to its earlier conversation.
session.revivedFromTranscript: The agent was restarted, but its backend couldn't pick the earlier conversation back up. Deskmony attaches the earlier transcript ({{count}} messages) to the first message the agent receives so it can read it — it continues from the record, it doesn't actually remember.
session.revivedFromTranscriptTruncated: The agent was restarted, but its backend couldn't pick the earlier conversation back up. Deskmony attaches the earlier transcript (the most recent {{count}} messages — older ones were left out because it is too long) to the first message the agent receives so it can read it — it continues from the record, it doesn't actually remember.
session.revivedWithoutMemory: The agent was restarted. This agent (a terminal program) doesn't keep memory of the earlier conversation, so it starts from scratch.
session.agentStopped: The agent stopped running (its process exited or its connection to Deskmony was lost). Sending your next message will restart it automatically.
session.rewoundFromTranscript: Rewound to just before the selected message — that message and everything after it were removed. The agent now has a fresh conversation, and Deskmony attaches the transcript that was kept ({{count}} messages, text only — no tool results from back then) to the next message it receives so it can read it — it continues from the record, it doesn't actually remember. Files the agent already changed are not restored.
session.rewoundFromTranscriptTruncated: Rewound to just before the selected message — that message and everything after it were removed. The agent now has a fresh conversation, and Deskmony attaches the transcript that was kept (the most recent {{count}} messages, text only — no tool results from back then; older ones were left out because it is too long) to the next message it receives so it can read it — it continues from the record, it doesn't actually remember. Files the agent already changed are not restored.
session.rewoundFresh: Rewound to the start of the conversation — the selected message and everything after it were removed. The agent now has a fresh conversation with nothing from before. Files the agent already changed are not restored.
session.rewoundDeferred: Rewound to just before the selected message — that message and everything after it were removed. The agent isn't running right now; the next time you send a message it is restarted with a fresh conversation, and the transcript that was kept (text only — no tool results from back then) is attached to that message so it can read it (it doesn't actually remember). Files the agent already changed are not restored.
session.forkedFromTranscript: This conversation was forked from "{{title}}": the messages before the fork point were copied over. The agent was started fresh, and Deskmony attaches that transcript ({{count}} messages, text only — no tool results from back then) to the first message it receives so it can read it — it continues from the record, it doesn't actually remember. Files were not restored; anything the agent changed earlier stays as it is.
session.forkedFromTranscriptTruncated: This conversation was forked from "{{title}}": the messages before the fork point were copied over. The agent was started fresh, and Deskmony attaches that transcript (the most recent {{count}} messages, text only — no tool results from back then; older ones were left out because it is too long) to the first message it receives so it can read it — it continues from the record, it doesn't actually remember. Files were not restored; anything the agent changed earlier stays as it is.
session.forkedFresh: This conversation was forked from the very start of "{{title}}", so there is nothing from before. The agent was started fresh. Files were not restored; anything the agent changed earlier stays as it is.
